structural_breaks.note: Spin-off from Siemens AG and listing; FY2020 and earlier quarters are combined (carve-out) figures printed as comparatives.

revenue_division_legacy only: the Q1 FY2022 release restated the Q1 FY2021 Transmission external-revenue comparative from 1,295 (as printed in the Q1 FY2021 release) to 1,251. Q2–Q4 FY2021 comparatives were unchanged. The FY2021Q1 point keeps the as-reported 1,295, and FY2022Q1 YoY uses the printed comparative 1,251. Grid Technologies and group revenue are not affected.

From FY2023 new segments Gas Services, Grid Technologies, Transformation of Industry, Siemens Gamesa replace Gas and Power + SGRE; FY2022 quarters recast in FY2023 releases (e.g., GT Q1 FY22 revenue 1,323 vs legacy Transmission external revenue 1,298).

Agreement to sell Trench (bushings, instrument transformers, coils; 9 factories, ~2,400 staff) to Triton; closing expected H1 CY2024. Trench-related special items booked in Grid Technologies (Q1 FY24). Not recast.
